project-zomboid.note: Production egg #3 (Tekkura UUID). The three PZ plans point at it. Egg #1, renamed "Project Zomboid (old)", stays for the customer server already on it.

ark-survival-ascended.note: Peer port is always game +1, hence 2. RCON is used inside the container for clean shutdown. Its subcategory exists under "Ark: Survival" (hidden until it has products).

ark-survival-evolved.note: Raw UDP is always game +1, query is the 3rd port. The egg default admin password was PleaseChangeMe. Its subcategory exists under "Ark: Survival" (hidden until it has products).

minecraft-paper.note: USER_AGENT defaults to Tekkura's; PaperMC's API refuses downloads without one.

minecraft-vanilla.note: The standard start: Minecraft products point at this egg, and the customer picks their type on the Server type page afterwards.

minecraft-curseforge.note: Needs Tekkura's CurseForge API key as the egg default for API_KEY. Hidden from customers until it is set.

minecraft-modrinth.note: Used by the modpack installer, not shown as a software choice.

palworld.note: RCON stays inside the container (the console uses it), so it needs no allocation.

cs2.note: Steam token made optional: it is the customer's own credential. Without one the server is LAN only.

necesse.note: The port reaches the game through cfg/server.cfg.

unturned.note: Game +1 is required. Steam token made optional and passed only when set.

conan-exiles.note: Game +1 is fixed, query is the 3rd port. Players connect on the game port (1st).

valheim.note: Query is always game +1. The join password defaulted to "secret" on every server; now generated.

valheim-bepinex.note: Query is always game +1. The join password defaulted to "secret" on every server; now generated.

terraria.note: The port reaches the game through serverconfig.txt.

arma-reforger.note: The port reaches the game through config.json. A2S and RCON are optional and off.

windrose.note: Invite codes work without it; DirectIP must match the game port, so it follows port 1.

arma-3.note: Game, +1 query, +2 Steam, +3 VON and +4 BattlEye are fixed offsets, hence a run of 5; RCON (required, no default upstream) gets the 6th. The customer supplies the Steam login (STEAM_USER/STEAM_PASS viewable, editable, optional; on the panel since 2026-10-19). The server builds, the first install stops with the installer's own message until they enter it; once both are filled the panel reinstalls it by itself (eggs.reinstall_variables). Their own account is the only way Workshop mods download, since that needs Arma 3 ownership.

minecraft-quilt.note: Upstream shipped no features; given eula, java_version and pid_limit like the other Java eggs.

minecraft-spongeforge.note: Superseded: the Sponge egg (minecraft-spongevanilla) installs SpongeVanilla, SpongeForge and SpongeNeo through SPONGE_TYPE, and supports current Java. This one stops at Java 18.

minecraft-purpur-geyser.note: Geyser's Bedrock listener is pointed at the server's own port (UDP side) through plugins/Geyser-Spigot/config.yml; Bedrock players use the same address.

minecraft-velocity.note: USER_AGENT defaults to Tekkura's; PaperMC's API refuses downloads without one.

rust.note: Query, web RCON (admin tools) and the Rust+ companion app all need to be reachable, so each gets a port; one spare. RCON password generated.

dayz.note: Query is needed for the server list. Like Arma 3, it installs only with a real Steam login, which the customer supplies; the server reinstalls itself once both are filled.

bot-nodejs.note: Node.js 24 LTS by default, 26 and 22 offered; 23 and 25 dropped (end of life). Running is the entrypoint's `:/home/container$ ` line. Kind bot: no ports by default (required_ports 0 needs the panel's bot kind first, see the panel's docs/PLATFORM-PLAN.md), the web port add-on brings one. With no repository the install leaves a placeholder that prints what to do and idles, so a store order starts and reads Running. Setting GIT_ADDRESS reinstalls by itself (reinstall) and the placeholder is removed first. Checked in Docker on the real images 2026-10-26: no repo, then repo set and reinstalled. Not on the panel yet.

bot-python.note: Python 3.13 by default, 3.10 to 3.14 offered; 3.7 to 3.9 dropped (end of life). Running is the entrypoint's `container~ ` line. Upstream's install checked for requirements.txt while installing REQUIREMENTS_FILE; fixed. Kind bot: no ports by default (required_ports 0 needs the panel's bot kind first, see the panel's docs/PLATFORM-PLAN.md), the web port add-on brings one. With no repository the install leaves a placeholder that prints what to do and idles, so a store order starts and reads Running. Setting GIT_ADDRESS reinstalls by itself (reinstall) and the placeholder is removed first. Checked in Docker on the real images 2026-10-26: no repo, then repo set and reinstalled. Not on the panel yet.
